title: Second Supplementary Law as the Fourth Reduction Lemma

problemStatement.formal: theorem legendreSym_two_eq (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ≠ 2) : legendreSym p 2 = χ₈ (p : ZMod 8)
problemStatement.plain: Can the second supplementary law (2/p) = (-1)^((p^2-1)/8) be packaged as a fourth reduction lemma completing the Legendre-symbol algorithm toolkit? YES — Mathlib gives the computable character form legendreSym p 2 = χ₈ (p mod 8) (legendreSym.at_two), exposed as the fourth one-line wrapper. The textbook exponential form is equivalent but not a named Mathlib lemma.
whyMatters: Completes the standalone GCD-style Legendre-symbol algorithm: multiplicativity + (-1/p) + reciprocity swap + (2/p)
The χ₈ form is the directly computable one the algorithm evaluates (value depends only on p mod 8)
Pins the precise residual gap: the classical (-1)^((p^2-1)/8) form needs a χ₈-to-exponent bridge absent from Mathlib
